description: Figure 3.2 illustrates the ROUGE-1 metric for fine-tuning MBart and T5 models with adapters using different values of the parameter $ r $, evaluated on the Gazeta dataset. The x-axis represents $ \log r $, with values ranging from 0 to 8, and is labeled as $ \log r $. The y-axis represents the ROUGE-1 score, with values ranging from 0 to 35, and is labeled as "ROUGE-1". The graph contains four lines, each corresponding to a different model and adapter configuration: "T5 + LoRA" (red, solid line with circular markers), "MBart + LoRA" (blue, solid line with circular markers), "T5 + AdaLoRA" (green, solid line with circular markers), and "MBart + AdaLoRA" (orange, solid line with circular markers). The "T5 + LoRA" line starts at a ROUGE-1 score of approximately 23 and increases to about 28. The "MBart + LoRA" line starts at a ROUGE-1 score of approximately 12, drops to about 5 at $ \log r = 1 $, then rises to a score of about 27. The "T5 + AdaLoRA" line begins at a ROUGE-1 score of approximately 23 and steadily increases to a score of about 36. The "MBart + AdaLoRA" line starts at a ROUGE-1 score of approximately 12, increases to about 30, and then plateaus.
